policy: Corrects only clear errors in source labels, found on widely known works or in the human audit sample, judged against the work's standard bibliographic description. Removing labels is preferred over adding them. Country follows Wikidata's country of origin, which usually records the country of first publication; corrections never switch it to an author-origin rule. Raw Wikidata statements stay in source_selection.jsonl. A work left with no mapped genre leaves the catalog.
review: The human audit reviewed a sample of these corrections (catalog_audit_sample.json).

Q6511.title: Ulysses
Q6511.reason: A novel, not a memoir; Wikidata's autobiography statement refers to its autobiographical elements.

Q774233.title: Journey to the End of the Night
Q774233.reason: A semi-autobiographical novel, not a memoir.

Q129778.title: Heart of Darkness
Q129778.reason: Set in the author's present (1890s Congo Free State), so not historical fiction.

Q271764.title: Lord of the Flies
Q271764.reason: An allegorical survival novel, not science fiction.

Q1541914.title: The Handmaid's Tale
Q1541914.reason: Set in a speculative future, so not historical fiction.

Q41542.title: Dracula
Q41542.reason: A Gothic horror novel; 'romance' here is the older literary sense, not the romance genre.

Q1141032.title: Manon Lescaut
Q1141032.reason: A novel framed as fictional memoirs, not a memoir.

Q219457.title: A Journey to the Centre of the Earth
Q219457.reason: Written in French; English is the language of translations.

Q13912.title: Where the Wild Things Are
Q13912.reason: An American picture book written in English; Spanish is a translation. Children added: a canonical children's picture book.

Q471005.title: The Mysterious Island
Q471005.reason: Serialized 1874-1875 and published in book form in 1875, not 1888.

Q130706737.title: Brainchild
Q130706737.reason: A magazine novella (Analog, 1982) with no book edition; not a recommendable book.

Q207964.title: Digital Fortress
Q207964.reason: First published in the United States; the United Kingdom statement is spurious.

Q1657842.title: Igraine the Brave
Q1657842.reason: The German original (Igraine Ohnefurcht) appeared in 1998; 2007 is the English translation.

Q19358463.title: The Prone Gunman
Q19358463.reason: La Position du tireur couché was published by Gallimard in 1981.

Q123020418.title: Engineers of the Soul
Q123020418.reason: The Dutch original (Ingenieurs van de ziel) appeared in 2002.

Q141476772.title: Zed: Volume One
Q141476772.reason: A partial self-published collection superseded by the complete edition; an edition, not the work.

Q3476505.title: Rainbow Troops
Q3476505.reason: A coming-of-age novel about schoolchildren, not a romance.

Q7727262.title: The Conan Grimoire
Q7727262.reason: Essays on sword-and-sorcery plus verse; fantasy is the subject, not the genre.

Q811229.title: A Small Circus
Q811229.reason: A political and social novel about a farmers' revolt; satirical in places, not a humor book.

Q135928165.title: Ekhan Umal Chadar
Q135928165.reason: The romanization drops the final vowel of the Assamese title (এখনি উমাল চাদৰ, the work's own title statement).

Q5505671.title: From the Holy Mountain
Q5505671.reason: First published in 1997 (HarperCollins, London); 1998 is the paperback.

Q7737801.title: The Great Hydration
Q7737801.reason: First published as a print-on-demand edition in 2002; 2005 is a later trade edition. The description repeated the wrong year.

Q7721796.title: The Cay
Q7721796.reason: Published in 1969, as the year field already says; the description's 1974 is the year of the TV film adaptation.
